title: Calculate Age
description: Write `age(born, today)` where both are `YYYY-MM-DD` texts. Return the age in whole years on `today` (a birthday counts on the day itself).
starter_code:

    # Write your code here

hints: Start with the difference in years.
Subtract one if the birthday has not happened yet this year: compare (month, day) tuples.
solution_code:
from datetime import datetime

def age(born, today):
    b = datetime.strptime(born, '%Y-%m-%d')
    t = datetime.strptime(today, '%Y-%m-%d')
    years = t.year - b.year
    if (t.month, t.day) < (b.month, b.day):
        years -= 1
    return years
